settings.reference: GLORYS reanalysis, harmonised to the 0.25 degree grid

bootstrap.kind: moving-block bootstrap over test days (overlapping blocks, no wrap)
bootstrap.estimator: per-day sufficient statistics averaged over the seeds of the experiment (and of its full-input reference), metrics from the resampled sums

settings.established: paired interval excludes zero AND the per-seed RMSE ranges of the two methods do not overlap
settings.permutation: within the calendar month (random derangement of each month's days; all channels of a group from the same donor day), averaged over repeats
